translations.idomain-page.apps.body: In iDeploy as in iCode, you buy the name without leaving your application: it connects itself to the site you have just put online. No redirection, no second account, the same wallet.
translations.idomain-page.apps.title: Already online with IDEM?
translations.idomain-page.ecosystem.icode.description: The site or the application the name is for — written, then put online, then named.
translations.idomain-page.ecosystem.ideploy.descripti: The hosting the name points at. Buy the name from inside iDeploy and it connects itself.
translations.idomain-page.guarantee.holder.descriptio: You are the registered holder. Ask for the transfer code and we hand it over, free of charge — that is the only real guarantee there is.
translations.idomain-page.guarantee.holder.title: The name is yours, and it leaves with you
translations.idomain-page.guarantee.price.description: It is held for the whole of your order, even if a rate changes in between. The renewal price is shown before you pay, not a year later.
translations.idomain-page.guarantee.price.title: The price you saw is the price you pay
translations.idomain-page.guarantee.refund.descriptio: If someone registers it first, the amount goes back into your wallet automatically. You do not have to ask.
translations.idomain-page.guarantee.refund.title: Refunded if the name gets away
translations.idomain-page.guarantees.lede: The same price whenever you buy. What a registrar can promise is narrow, so here is exactly what we do promise — and the registration rules say the rest, including what we cannot change.
translations.idomain-page.guarantees.title: One price, and no surprises
translations.idomain-page.hero.lede: Buy your domain name from your IDEM wallet, in mobile money. It is registered in your name, connected to your site and secured with HTTPS — and you set nothing up.
translations.idomain-page.included.connect.descriptio: One move attaches the name to the site you just put online with iDeploy or iCode.
translations.idomain-page.included.connect.title: Connected to your application
translations.idomain-page.included.dns.description: Your site’s address is written and kept up to date. The advanced records are there if you want them, hidden if you do not.
translations.idomain-page.included.dns.title: DNS managed for you
translations.idomain-page.included.https.description: The padlock is obtained and renewed without you doing anything, for as long as the name is connected.
translations.idomain-page.included.https.title: Automatic HTTPS
translations.idomain-page.included.lede: Not an upsell list: everything below comes with the name, at the price shown.
translations.idomain-page.included.mail.description: Connecting your site touches only its address. Your e-mail and your other records are never overwritten.
translations.idomain-page.included.mail.title: Your mail stays where it is
translations.idomain-page.included.manage.description: State, deadline, advanced DNS, transfer code — in your language, in one screen.
translations.idomain-page.included.manage.title: One place for everything
translations.idomain-page.included.reminders.descript: You are warned ahead of time, with the renewal price. A name is not lost because an e-mail went missing.
translations.idomain-page.included.reminders.title: Reminders before the deadline
translations.idomain-page.included.title: Included with every name
translations.idomain-page.setup.body: You can close the page: the installation carries on without you, and you find its state again under « My domains ».
translations.idomain-page.setup.connected.description: The DNS records are written for you and your application answers to that name. You open no technical panel.
translations.idomain-page.setup.connected.title: Address written, site connected
translations.idomain-page.setup.paid.description: Debited from your IDEM wallet, topped up by mobile money. No card, no bank form.
translations.idomain-page.setup.paid.title: Payment received
translations.idomain-page.setup.registered.descriptio: You are the holder — not us. The name is yours, and you can take it to another registrar whenever you want.
translations.idomain-page.setup.registered.title: Name registered in your name
translations.idomain-page.setup.secured.description: The certificate is obtained and renewed on its own. Your visitors see a site they can trust.
translations.idomain-page.setup.secured.title: HTTPS padlock switched on
translations.idomain-page.setup.title: You pay. IDEM does the rest.
